text:
Marathon Petroleum stock rose nearly 0.7% today as part of a strong nine-day rally that has added almost 10% to its value. The company benefits directly from the current operating environment: U.S. refineries are running at 96.8% capacity—near maximum utilization—while global oil prices remain elevated at $130.80 per barrel, which widens the profit margins refiners capture between crude input costs and finished fuel sales. The persistent geopolitical tension in the Middle East, including reported incidents near Saudi airports and ongoing conflict raising supply disruption concerns, has kept oil prices elevated and supported the refining sector.

The broader backdrop of record diesel prices underscores why refiner margins remain attractive. High energy costs are already rippling through trucking and transportation, which depends on steady diesel supply—meaning demand for refined products remains robust even as prices climb, supporting continued strong utilization rates at refineries like those Marathon operates.
